instruction: Change the font of all text in the document to Times New Roman. Ensure all runs of text use the Times New Roman font family.

parameters.window_name: 04 CHIN9505 EBook Purchasing info 2021 Jan.docx - LibreOffice Writer

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all text font to Times New Roman. The evaluator checks that all runs with text content use the Times New Roman font family.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 1.0 if all text runs use Times New Roman font, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all text runs in the document for Times New Roman font
Complete coverage: checks all paragraphs and all runs with text content
Proper data flow: document file retrieval -> python-docx parsing -> font verification
Postconfig appropriately saves document before verification (Ctrl+S)
Metric logic correctly skips whitespace-only runs and checks only text-bearing runs
Expected value is semantically correct for the task requirement
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor consideration: The metric returns 0.0 if run.font.name is None. In some cases, fonts may be inherited from paragraph/document styles. However, given the explicit instruction 'Ensure all runs use Times New Roman', requiring explicit font setting is acceptable.
